crossRefs.note: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told…
Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to…
Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but…

translations.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
translations.bsb: And the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones. I told this dream to the magicians, but no one could explain it to me.”
translations.kjv: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare
translations.asv: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears: and I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
